📄 IDB comments due COB. Sonia is away.
10:00-11:00 — departmental briefing, Global Food Security Crisis, Super El Niño focus.

📄 The OPS is with you. Two things to settle: where 4.1 million comes from, and whether CONRED has moved off the yellow alert. And the Oxfam study has a second, larger figure: 51,000 households projected to be impacted.
MON 7 SEPT — clear so far.
TUE 8 SEPT 14:00 — CMM/OPS.
WED 9 SEPT — 'Visit to PAS Escobal', all-day placeholder. Pan American Silver's mine, suspended since 2017 pending ILO 169 consultation. Worth one question about what the day actually is.
THU 10 SEPT — DEV team 09:00, NDB/Mission IA Management 11:30.
FRI 11 SEPT 11:00 — Cervecería C.A. tour, lunch after. 🎂 Helen's birthday.
MON 14 SEPT 14:00 — bilat with Olivier. The list is six weeks stale and wants a prune.
TUE 15 SEPT — Independence Day. Mission holiday. Accepting nothing.
Write to Jean-Luc: Olivier wants you to apply for the FS-03. Three-line draft already written.
🅿️ Send Annick the address of the parking lot in Antigua.
🍁 Pick the October dates for Quebec. Olivier cannot answer the leave ask without them.

Driver's licence + health card address. 🔴 New card takes 4-6 WEEKS, so it lands after you fly home on the 23rd. Use a MAILING address separate from the residential one: Bernice's, 925 9th Ave A E. ⚠️ If it is an Enhanced licence there is no online option.
Canada Post forwarding mailbox. 🔴 Do the ID change FIRST. Ontario mails the card 'do not forward', so a redirect cannot carry it. Your own catch, 11 Aug.
Collect the Diallog REPLACEMENT router. ⚠️ If the old one is being swapped, re-check the VOIP: SIP ALG off on the NEW box before assuming the phone is still broken.

Call Diallog about the house phone not ringing. Ask them ONE thing directly: is the number provisioned for INBOUND, not just outbound? Tell them outgoing works and shows the right caller ID, so registration is fine. That skips twenty minutes of scripted troubleshooting.

Home phone: move to the $5 ISP-independent plan and PORT the number. Diallog and you both spent hours and it never rang, including with the handset straight into the modem, so the router is ruled out.
Take the monitors to the basement.
Utilities scheduling for 1080. Ticked on the page in July but still open in your HOME tree, tagged #julie is doing this.
Set up the computer apps at 1080. From your HOME tree, not previously on this list.
Write to the agent to explain. Still in your HOME tree and still unexplained; tell me what it means and I will make it concrete.
File the reconciliation for the FSD 50 advance
⏳ TRIGGER STEP, do this early: ask Lily's school for the enrolment letter. The registrar holds the clock. 28 Nov is when the coverage must EXIST, not when to start asking.
Upload Lily's proof of enrolment
Send the enquiry about furniture delivery
File the dental claim
Honduras Uber period ~$1,000: verify window with Rizki first
Guatemala City Uber period ~$1,000: same, verify window
MyGCPay shows 5 open items under Cases and Enquiries. One look next time you are in there.
✅ Video filmed and claim submitted 24 Aug. The video was the last blocker.
⏳ They quote 1-2 business days to reply, up to 7 for the decision. So expect an answer around WED 26 AUG.
🔴 The real problem is not the wait: you are no longer in Canada with the glasses. If they answer this week, who mails it? Warranty runs to ~19 May 2027, so Christmas costs you nothing but patience.
When they send an address: ORIGINAL PACKAGING and a TRACKABLE method, both required. You are in Canada until the 23rd, so ship from there rather than from Guatemala.
The telephone game story. Still owed. The ~1990 pamphlet turned up in July.

LORE: the AltspaceVR Dhaka year. All sources now located and mapped. Still to do: read the two Katie Kelly emails, the Microsoft prep doc and the VRLA script, then write YOUR version into lore. The Seattle Times has the journalism; your account is not written down anywhere.
From your LIFE tree, unfiled until tonight: the unfinished videogame projects, vibe-coding, and hardware projects. Three standing categories, no tasks under them yet.
📱 Buy Julie data.
Wingspan Etsy items for Julie's gift
Mirage 3D hologram maker
Ticket to Ride: Northern Lights
Apple Watch USB-C charger cable
From your Workflowy home list, unchanged for eight days: door handles, floor lamps, telephone stand, TV stand, VGA cable, bright bulbs, VOIP handset, IP cameras.
The first thing to build after deploy: the bilat bullet, shared, both of us editing. One live bullet before the next bilat, not a full import.
🔴 RENAME IT FIRST. Your call, 23 Aug: Nest is the doorbell company, and you are installing a door lock and cameras at 1080.
Deploy Nest: openssl rand -hex 24 → paste into NEST_KEY in api.php → upload both files to public_html/nest/ → open the URL, hit ⚙, paste key. Then send Orson the URL and key.
In cPanel, make an FTP account restricted to public_html/nest/ for Orson. Not the master login.

The 1080 house app: rooms, jobs with a status pipeline, contractors as their own records, shared with Julie. Spec written from your dictation. Open question: you, Fable, or me writing the prompt for Fable.
Turn on Time Machine to an external drive. There is still no backup of the closet Mac.
⌨️ F12 in Brave: try changing the Services shortcut to ⌃F12 or ⇧F12. Brave only grabs bare F12. Nothing to install.
🤖 ChatGPT launcher: replace the Automator contents with one Run Shell Script line, open -a "<browser>" "https://chatgpt.com". Opening a URL forces a window.
VOIP at 1080: dials out but does not ring on incoming. Check SIP ALG off on the Diallog router first, then shorten the registration/keepalive interval, then confirm the number is provisioned inbound.
Look up moving the Plex library to the cloud. The Canada side cannot watch, and the Guatemala outage is exactly why: a home-hosted server dies with the house internet.
Add the Quest Games Optimizer
Arcade1Up Pac-Man cabinet mod (Pi 3B or MiSTer)
Look up a YouTube video about documenting AGI
ChatGPT as an app via Canary browser (from your HOME tree)
Test if Telegram/OpenClaw works on the $9/mo ChatGPT tier
Work calendar shortcut, when you're next in it: add a Show Notification step so the button says it fired. That was the whole bug. The 03:00 automation still doesn't run.
